question.prompt: The distance between points A and B is 7 cm, and C is any point in the plane. What is the minimum value of \(AC+BC\), in cm?

solutions.explanation: By the fact that the line segment between two points is the shortest path, \(AC+BC\geq AB=7\text{ cm}\). Equality holds when C lies on segment AB, so the minimum value is 7.
solutions.title: Shortest path and equality
